summary: Reaction particle system initializer. Caches physics/rendering constants from globals (restitution square, sum and sqrt2-scaled values) into 0x005D3488-0x005D3494, applies a render-throttle shift to the particle count when a2 is set, then, when the frame-throttled count is positive, builds a per-reaction resource name, registers it through sub_559200, and on success allocates and initializes a particle array (108-byte stride entries plus a secondary index array). For reaction type 13 (weather noise) it fills wind-noise spread and normalized direction tables by hashing a stream from flt_8AB274. Called by SpecialFX_Init during special-effects initialization.

operations.description: Square global flt_7CF974 and store the result into flt_5D348C.
Sum flt_7CF974 and dword_7CF998 (as float) into flt_5D3490, then scale flt_5D3494 by 1.4142135 times that sum.
Guard on argument a2 (apply render-throttle frame-count adjustment).
Set this+0x08 to (4 - dword_7CF8A8). When dword_7CF8A8 is nonzero, right-shift this+0x58 by that amount; otherwise zero this+0x58 and this+0x64.
Guard on this+0x58 > 0 (positive particle/reaction frame count).
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck on the buffer at this+0x50 with format literal 'Reaction%02d' (aReaction02d) using reaction ID this+0x00.
Write into the object referenced by this+0x50 at offsets 0x24/0x28/0x2C/0x30: the frame count this+0x58 and the three parameters this+0x0C, this+0x10, this+0x14.
Call sub_559200(this + 84, this+0x50) to register/load the named reaction; the truthy result selects the error-report path.

On registration failure: StringRelocationCopy(0, stack buffer), then StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_25, 873) / (…, 876) error-parse steps; each truthy result triggers DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aCouldNotCreate_1) or DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aCubeErrorS).
Allocate particle array via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(108 * count + 4) using count this+0x58; store count in the header and SentinelFieldInit each 108-byte-strided entry.
Store array pointer into this+0x5C, zero this+0x60; compute this+0x40 as 1.0/this+0x30 (or 0.0 when this+0x30 <= 0.0); zero this+0x64.
Allocate the secondary index array via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(4 * count) and store into this+0x68.

Iterate over count entries: write entry index and link -1 into the array at this+0x5C, call ParticlePositionSetup on each entry with floats this+0x30/0x34/0x38/0x3C, and zero the matching slot in this+0x68.
Guard on this+0x04 == 13 (weather noise particle system type).

Weather branch: reset dword_8ACEDC, then build a wind-noise spread table into the flt_8ACAA4 region using values from the flt_8AB274 stream (scaled by 20.0) and DeterministicHashPseudoRandomGenerator(&dword_8AAE70) masked to 0x1FFFF and mapped to [-20, 20], rejecting pairs while x^2 + y^2 >= 400, until the flt_8ACEA4 boundary.

Weather branch: from consecutive flt_8AB274 samples build normalized 3-vector directions into the unk_8AC828 region (normalize by 1/sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2), with a y=1 fallback for zero length), reading flt_8AAE74 per step to write fall-speed -24.0 - v*3.0 every 10 floats, until the flt_8ACAA8 boundary.
Return the accumulated byte value v2 (final StringSplitLoop/DebugLogWrite status, or a2-derived value when no reaction block ran).

if (hdr) { hdr[0] = this[0x58]; for each 108-byte entry: SentinelFieldInit(entry); }
